t: The Sylvania Sylpipe single 4ft LED linkable batten is an efficient lighting solution, providing bright, versatile illumination for various indoor applications. This 15W LED batten is ideal for trade professionals needing reliable lighting in workshops, garages, or for under cabinet installations in kitchens and utility rooms. It delivers 2020 lumens and offers users the choice of selecting from warm white (3000K), cool white (4000K), or daylight (6500K) colour temperatures via an integrated switch. Its seamless linking capability allows up to 10 metres of continuous light, perfect for longer runs. Supplied with all fixings, including standard and tilting brackets, for flexible ceiling or wall mounting.
b: L x W x H: 1200mm x 24mm x 35mm
Supplied with 0.3m Stripped Cable for Easy Wiring
Link up to 10m for Extended Lighting Runs
